columnFieldDefUuids.description: Metadata/column field-definition references — each element is a definition's `uuid`, or (new in the same push) its `key`.

requiredFieldDefUuids.description: Governance: keys of the type's table fields a table of the type must fill (`field.required:<key>`). Absent = none.

requiredColumnFieldDefUuids.description: Governance: keys of the type's column fields every column must fill (`field.required:<key>`). Absent = none.

allowedFlagUuids.description: Governance: names of the flags a column of the type may carry (`flag.notAllowed:<name>`). Absent = every flag.

systemColumnPattern.description: Governance: a regex on column names; a matching column that is none of the type's `columnTemplates` is an unknown system column (`systemColumn.unknown`). Absent = no check.

V3ConfigTableType.description: `columnFields`/`tableFields` are the readable companions of `columnFieldDefUuids`/`metadataFieldDefUuids` — each referenced definition's `key`, in the same order (a uuid naming no definition is skipped). With the uuid list present the two must agree or the import is rejected; alone, each key resolves to its definition. Companions are never stored: the export derives them again.

required.description: Governance: every table of the type must have this column (`systemColumn.missing:<name>`). Absent = false.

V3ConfigColumnTemplate.description: A standard column a table type adds. `dataType` is the readable companion of `dataTypeUuid` (the datatype's `name`), and `flags` of `flagUuids` (each flag's `name`): the import rejects the two disagreeing, and resolves the names when the uuids are absent.
